scope: Bounded analogue experiment for the representative pilot, at the fully specified 5 V / 25 C typical manufacturer-model point. Full operating-envelope/physical qualification remains PILOT-05.
fixture_note: 50 pF plus 1 kohm opposing the transition: to ground for a rising edge, to 5 V for a falling edge. This retains TI's resistive fixture and adds the explicit receiver/wiring capacitance. It is an experiment load, not an added normal-schematic part.
timing_interpretation: Start the complete extracted output-shape waveform after source + ROM + buffer delay. Its leading idle time is retained as extra experiment delay, not reinterpreted as a guaranteed propagation time. Test the full setup/hold window enlarged on both sides by clock uncertainty.
numerical_note: 10 mV correlation tolerance is 1.25% of the tighter 0.8 V threshold; 0.1 ns timing tolerance is 1% of the existing 10 ns uncertainty allocation. Neither tolerance changes logic thresholds or capture timing.
unqualified: physical receiver, socket and PCB parasitics versus the 50 pF allocation
power/ground bounce, simultaneous switching and transmission-line effects
production PVT guarantees and missing minimum/maximum C_comp
output-enable handover, whole-machine timing and physical clock/reset
